email.body1:
Flynn, saw Ridgeline crossed $650B in committed AUM and shipped both Market Intelligence and Intelligent Outcomes this year.

Growth that fast usually means more investment-manager accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Ridgeline off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Flynn, quick follow-up for Ridgeline.

With new products like Intelligent Outcomes live, expansion targets usually jump faster than headcount can keep up. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Ridgeline needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Flynn, last bit of proof for Ridgeline.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ridgeline's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Flynn, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority for Ridgeline this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after big platform milestones, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Ridgeline either way.
